Knowledge facts: part C holds 46 fact blocks (sec02-F01 onward) from physical pages 7 to 12; part C2 holds 16 confusable and continuation blocks (sec02-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 handbook, the 50-question knowledge test and its 80 percent (40 of 50) passing standard from physical page 5; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- WI-PROG-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook, only an expected duration (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- WI-PROG-D-POINTS — scope of doubled points for second or later convictions during the GDL phase (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- WI-PROG-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- WI-PROG-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the document list, fees, the REAL ID enforcement date, renewal channels, the RoadReady app and the DMV new-resident and sponsor web pages (for example sec02-F29, sec02-F46) can change and must be refreshed from the Wisconsin DMV website.
